subject: Halloween week: trick-or-treating, Zoo Boo and more
preheader: Welcome to the first Littles List: our favorite kid plans for the next two weeks.
intro: Welcome to the very first Littles List! Every Monday, we'll send our favorite things to do with babies through elementary schoolers in Spring Branch and Memorial over the next two weeks, so you have time to plan.

It's Halloween week, so costumes are the theme. If you only do one thing, make it CityCentre's free trick-or-treat on Friday evening (bring your own bucket). And if a costume meltdown is in your future, our new article on tantrums is for you.

items.title: Greenside, a family-friendly spot with a kids' play structure, is coming to Memorial City
items.description: A new family-friendly hangout built around a one-acre lawn is coming to 1085 Gessner, with a children's play area in the plans. Michelin-recognized Pizzana is among the restaurants opening there this fall.
paragraphs: A new family-friendly hangout built around a one-acre lawn is coming to 1085 Gessner, with a children's play area in the plans. Michelin-recognized Pizzana is among the restaurants opening there this fall.

image.alt: Rendering of Greenside's garden: kids playing in and around two wooden A-frame playhouses among flowering trees, while parents sit on long benches nearby.

image.alt: Illustration: Young kids (ages 4–8) in cute costumes (dinosaur, ladybug, superhero, princess) doing a Halloween craft and dancing at a library party with paper bats and pumpkins on the walls

items.title: Halloween party for kids
items.description: A costume-friendly Halloween party at the library for ages 4–8.

image.alt: Illustration: Excited kids in Halloween costumes exploring a colorful hands-on children's museum in the evening: a giant bubble station and climbing structure, families everywhere

items.title: Free Family Night at the Children's Museum
items.where: Children's Museum Houston, 1500 Binz St (worth the drive)
items.description: Free admission Thursday evening, plus trick-or-treating and the Halloween Happy House. Arrive early; it fills up.

image.alt: Illustration: Little kids in costumes with pumpkin buckets trick-or-treating along an outdoor shopping plaza with shops and restaurants, orange balloons marking the doors, parents nearby, late afternoon golden light

items.title: CityCentre trick-or-treat
items.description: Kids trick-or-treat at CityCentre shops and restaurants marked with balloons. Rain or shine; bring your own bucket.

image.alt: Illustration: Kids in Halloween costumes (lion, bee, astronaut, witch) walking along a zoo path lined with pumpkins and hay bales, a giraffe in the background, families smiling, sunny fall day

items.title: Zoo Boo at the Houston Zoo
items.where: Houston Zoo, 6200 Hermann Park Dr (worth the drive)
items.description: Pumpkins, fall decorations, photo spots and animals getting Halloween treats. Costumes welcome.

image.alt: Illustration: Kids (ages 4–10) with clipboards and crayons on a forest trail, holding up colorful fall leaves to match a scavenger-hunt sheet, parents walking behind

items.title: Fall Foliage scavenger hunt
items.description: A free family scavenger hunt on the trails about fall leaves, any time between 2 and 4 pm. Turn in your sheet at the Nature Center for a prize.

image.alt: Illustration: A kids' craft tent in a botanic garden: children making tree crafts and hugging a big oak tree, a guide pointing up at the branches, families on a garden path

items.title: Standing Tall tree festival
items.where: Houston Botanic Garden, 1 Botanic Ln (worth the drive)
items.description: A kids' zone with tree-themed crafts and activities, plus guided walks to meet the garden's native trees.

items.title: Feges BBQ
items.description: Kids eat free on Wednesdays, 5 pm–8 pm. Barbecue with a big patio and a small enclosed play space with a climbing gym tucked beside it. You order at the counter, so no waiting in line with wiggly kids.

items.title: The Union Kitchen – Memorial
items.description: Free kids' meal on Mondays and Tuesdays. American comfort food with a spacious patio, a play area for kids and live music some nights.

items.title: Lazy Oaks Beer Garden
items.description: A shady, laid-back beer garden with a playground, so kids can climb while grown-ups relax.

image.alt: Illustration: A frustrated toddler with a pout sitting on a living room rug next to a toppled toy tower, a calm mom kneeling at eye level with open arms, soft afternoon light through the window, tender and reassuring mood

items.title: Tantrums aren't a sign you're failing. They're a sign your kid is two.
items.description: Almost every toddler melts down, and most tantrums are over in five minutes. What the research says is really going on, and what actually helps (for them and for you).

items.title: Kids eat free near Spring Branch: a night-by-night cheat sheet
items.description: Monday through Wednesday, there's a kids-eat-free deal near Spring Branch and Memorial every night. Here's where.

items.title: SBISD Thanksgiving break
items.description: No school all week. Plan library visits and park days early, since popular spots fill up.
